name: Summer Internship Program (grades 11 and 12)
org: Boys & Girls Club of Dane County
what_you_do: Interns work at one of 20 or more paid placements with outside employers. Fields include nonprofit work, health care, business, IT and science. You get weekly career training and a job coach.
who_can_apply: 11th and 12th graders (and college students) who are Boys & Girls Club members.
duration: About 8 weeks (June 22 to Aug 14 on the page)
deadline_text: The page says applications open March 30 and are due April 19. The page does not state the year, so treat it as a yearly pattern.
how_to_apply: Separate high school and college application forms are linked on the page.
notes: This is only for Club members. Schedules and places vary by placement.
